# External Data Audit

This directory contains candidate external traffic and accident datasets, provenance,
and audit notes. No Karachi route-level historical traffic dataset or public
record-level Karachi crash dataset was found.

## Selected: UCI Metro Interstate Traffic Volume (UCI 492)

- Source: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/492/metro+interstate+traffic+volume
- DOI: `10.24432/C5X60B`
- Licence: CC BY 4.0
- Coverage: I-94 westbound ATR station 301, Minneapolis-St Paul, Minnesota, USA
- Raw archive: `metro_interstate/metro_interstate_traffic_volume.zip`
- Raw archive size: 405,547 bytes
- Raw archive SHA256: `b99aeabcbd6cc86f642da3a79d90883425798f58abd3b3302da2fa19dda73768`
- Extracted CSV: `metro_interstate/extracted/Metro_Interstate_Traffic_Volume.csv.gz`
- Extracted CSV size: 405,373 bytes
- Extracted CSV SHA256: `0b3679ac15173f79c6dc6c5ef8a0798d806fa5c5d7f05c84a5fa711bd1b05f07`
- Raw rows: 48,204
- Unique hourly timestamps: 40,575
- Missing hourly slots in the full span: 11,976
- Usable rows after lag/calendar construction: 31,738
- Target: hourly `traffic_volume` in vehicles per hour

The archive contains 7,629 duplicate timestamp rows with identical traffic-volume
values; one row per timestamp was retained. Missing hours were not interpolated.
The older benchmark uses lagged volume and calendar features; the new experimental
departure-time model uses calendar-only features. This dataset is an external
single-sensor volume source. It has no Karachi observations, route IDs, route
geometry, speed, travel-time, or congestion target, so it is not used as a Karachi
route forecast.

Provenance generated by `scripts/train_traffic_model.py`:
`metro_interstate/provenance.json`.

## Selected: UK STATS19 Road Safety Data (2023-2025)

- Source: https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/road-safety-data
- Download pattern:
  `https://data.dft.gov.uk/road-accidents-safety-data/dft-road-casualty-statistics-collision-YYYY.csv`
- Licence: Open Government Licence v3.0
- Coverage: Great Britain (England, Scotland, Wales)
- Local files: `stats19/collision-2023.csv`, `stats19/collision-2024.csv`,
  `stats19/collision-2025.csv`
- Raw collision rows: 306,710
- Time span: 2023-01-01 00:00 to 2025-12-31 23:00
- Severity counts: fatal 4,477; serious 72,196; slight 230,037
- Target: hourly severity-weighted collisions using the documented policy
  fatal=10, serious=3, slight=1
- Hourly grid: 26,304 cells
- Model split: 18,388 train / 3,922 validation / 3,946 test, with a 24-hour embargo

File integrity:

| File | Bytes | SHA256 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `collision-2023.csv` | 19,790,001 | `0c01d4194b4e4c5e1b242a43c633bc30e22cf16e8becca698e63a37f71410cfa` |
| `collision-2024.csv` | 19,208,488 | `32a78f4662e309160f37b1ea2b82017e85e07b62a022d680da7140e88706a17c` |
| `collision-2025.csv` | 19,349,153 | `e699c19bdb82e47e449b6f3381ac87631865f6a31cef118c9955ba80ca870e2b` |

The first 2025 download was truncated at 12,720,589 bytes and was replaced with the
verified file above. Collision timestamps are used only for the calendar-time prior.
The data contain no Karachi records and are not corridor-matched to Karachi. They are
not a probability that a crash will occur on a selected Karachi route.

Provenance generated by `scripts/train_departure_models.py`:
`stats19/provenance.json`. Model metadata and held-out metrics are under
`models/departure_forecast/`; the report is
`reports/departure_forecast_evaluation.md`.

## Rejected: UCI Traffic Flow Forecasting (UCI 734)

- Source: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/734/traffic+flow+forecasting-1
- Licence: CC BY 4.0
- Archive: `traffic_flow_forecasting/traffic_flow_forecasting.zip`
- Archive size: 4,398,562 bytes
- Archive SHA256: `b09ebe53ec44228bfd008d35fb34d12174b5523f7a735d159d9eea326163bc45`
- Coverage: Northern Virginia/Washington D.C. capital region
- Structure: 36 sensors, 15-minute normalized volume, 1,261 train and 840 test
  samples, no absolute timestamps or geographic coordinates

Rejected because it cannot be aligned to calendar departure times or Karachi
routes, and it is external to Karachi.

## Rejected: UTD19

- Source: https://utd19.ethz.ch/
- Coverage: 40 cities, 23,541 detectors, about 170 million rows
- Access: registration/agreement
- No Karachi coverage; full dataset is far larger than needed for this prototype

## Rejected: Karachi Study Paper

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.61797/ijaaiml.v4i2.337
- Local PDF: `karachi_paper/gazder_2024_traffic_congestion.pdf`
- Study roads: Rashid Minhas Road, Shahra e Faisal Road, Main Korangi Road
- Method: smartphone GPX tracks collected with My Track
- No released raw dataset, repository, or data-availability statement was found.
  The article licence does not establish reuse rights for the raw tracks.

## Rejected: GitHub Synthetic Candidate

- Source: https://github.com/husnainatiq/karachi-traffic-forecasting
- Local file: `karachi_candidate_github/traffic_data_clean.csv`
- Rows: 26,064
- Every row has `is_synthetic=True`
- No repository licence
- Features were derived from Google Maps/Open-Meteo

Rejected because it is synthetic and has no licence. It must not be used for
training or presented as observed Karachi traffic.

## Rejected: Kaggle AetherGrid

- Source: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/shanza30/aethergrid-smart-mobility-data-50k
- Explicitly simulated data

Rejected because it is synthetic.
